limitations: NuGet license metadata is informational; upstream license terms still apply.
NuGet content fingerprints are compared to restore metadata; raw archive bytes are checked against their separate cache fingerprint.
Single-file helper descriptions come from serialized build outputs; executable hashes are checked separately, not by extracting embedded descriptions.
Optional speech/model downloads are separate from the app package and retain their own terms.
The speech native payload comes from the pinned official no-TTS release archive; its effectiveBundledSpeechRuntime record overrides any historical NuGet native dependency attribution.
This inventory does not assert vulnerability clearance, signing, or installation acceptance.
